sql: SELECT state_abbr, "year", sector_code, sales_million_kwh FROM energy.eia_electricity_prices WHERE state_abbr IN ('OR','VA','IA','US') AND sector_code='ALL' AND "year" IN (2019,2020,2024,2025) ORDER BY state_abbr, "year"
SELECT "year", sales_million_kwh FROM energy.eia_electricity_prices WHERE state_abbr='OR' AND sector_code='ALL' AND "year" BETWEEN 2015 AND 2025 ORDER BY "year"
